name: RAGFlow Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source retrieval-augmented generation and document-ingestion engine with self-hosted Docker deployment; no software subscription or per-document vendor quota.
watch_out: Recommended starting resources are 4 CPU cores, 16 GB RAM and 50 GB disk; Elasticsearch/Infinity and database dependencies require maintenance. LLM/embedding API and infrastructure costs are separate.
